tiktok.author: oleg.build
tiktok.body: This feels like one of those “wait… how is this free?” moments. OpenHuman is trending #1 on GitHub, and for good reason: it’s a private AI superintelligence that runs directly on your desktop. No API keys, no paid cloud plan, no hidden lock-in. Just a fully open-source AI agent you can actually control. What makes it wild is how personal it gets. Connect Gmail, Notion, GitHub, and Slack, and it auto-syncs into a local memory tree every 20 minutes. It can react to your screen, remember your workflow, and even join Google Meet like a real participant. Setup is surprisingly simple, especially compared to other AI agents. One command, desktop app installed, and you’re ready to go. Comment “open” and check the GitHub links. #AI #OpenSource #GitHub #AIAgent
